title: Tracing Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming
abstract: arXiv:2611.29960v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning can increase the success of automated red teaming but it also narrows the attack vector. This study asks where in the attacker-defender-judge learning loop does the narrowing begin and which mechanisms lead to a narrowing attack. Six mechanisms (defender adaptation, success edge, reward reinforcement, row cap, update size, and measurement) are tested across three experiment arms (co-trained, frozen defender, half learning rate) for twenty-four iterations. A frozen defender narrows attack diversity retention (ADR) earlier 0.496 relative to co-trained 0.891 at iteration twelve. Defender updates delay narrowing but dont prevent it. Successful attacks ("winners") have narrower attack diversity than the full set of generated attacks. translated_title: 追踪自适应大语言模型红队测试中攻击者多样性的缩减
translated_abstract: 强化学习可以提高自动化红队测试的成功率，但同时也会使攻击向量收窄。本研究探讨在攻击者-防御者-裁判学习循环中，多样性缩减从何处开始，以及哪些机制导致攻击范围收窄。研究在三个实验组（共同训练、冻结防御者、减半学习率）中进行了二十四轮迭代，测试了六种机制（防御者自适应、成功优势、奖励强化、行数上限、更新规模和度量方式）。结果表明，冻结的防御者会更早降低攻击多样性保留率（ADR），在第12轮迭代时为0.496，而共同训练组为0.891。防御者的更新会延缓但不能阻止多样性缩减。成功攻击（“赢家”）的攻击多样性比生成的全部攻击集更窄。与以往赢家最接近的攻击比与以往失败最接近的攻击成功率高10-15个百分点。这种“赢家邻近优势”在防御者更新后依然存在。
tldr: 本研究系统定位了大语言模型自适应红队测试中攻击多样性缩减的发生环节与机制，发现对“赢家”攻击的奖励强化是收窄主因，冻结防御者会加速这一过程，而防御者更新只能延缓但无法阻止多样性衰减。
en_tdlr: This study traces where and why attack diversity reduction begins in adaptive LLM red teaming, showing that reward reinforcement of successful "winner" attacks drives the narrowing, a frozen defender accelerates it earlier, and defender updates only delay but cannot prevent diversity loss.
